forecast.source: Project objective: 7-day forecasts. Days after the horizon are ignored.

flood_alert.source: Kenya Meteorological Department heavy rainfall advisories: heavy rainfall above 20 mm and very heavy rainfall above 50 mm in 24 hours. Applied here as rain_mm >= 20 (watch) and rain_mm >= 50 (warning).

planting_window.source: Published rainy-season onset definitions: 20 mm over 5 days with at least 3 rain days (rain day = at least 1 mm).
planting_window.limitation: Published definitions also require that no long dry spell follows, which needs 21 to 30 days of look-ahead. The forecast covers 7 days, so no dry-spell check is made.

sms.source: A single GSM-7 SMS holds 160 characters; the limit is one lower so every message is strictly under 160.

caveat: Rainfall forecasts are less reliable than temperature forecasts.
